Suggestions provided by AI scenarios and models are for reference only.

Users have a duty to carefully evaluate text before sending it.

Users remain responsible for their wording and are not exempt from responsibility simply because AI was used.
When you copy text or type, built-in features may provide reference suggestions, which may be inaccurate, erroneous, or unavailable when no suitable suggestion applies.

- Project-Authored & Created Content: Code, scenarios, candidate/phrase/symbol entries, and custom graphics created for this project are project content unless an external source is noted.
- On-Device Operation: Powered by an offline model without relying on cloud quotas; depending on the release version, the model may be bundled at install time or require additional download.
- librime: RIME Developers; BSD-3-Clause. Used for Bopomofo/Pinyin composition and candidate handling.
- Rime Bopomofo, Terra Pinyin, Prelude, and Essay: RIME Developers; upstream license is LGPL-3.0. Essay provides Chinese vocabulary candidate data.
- CC-CEDICT: MDBG / CC-CEDICT; CC BY-SA 3.0. Used in accordance with attribution and ShareAlike terms.
- OpenCC: BYVoid and contributors; Apache-2.0. Used for script conversion.
- Rime Native Static Dependencies: Native builds include components such as spdlog (MIT), yaml-cpp (MIT), LevelDB (BSD-3-Clause), marisa-trie (BSD-2-Clause or LGPL-2.1-or-later), Boost (BSL-1.0), and OpenCC (Apache-2.0) under their respective licenses.
- llamacpp-kotlin and llama.cpp: llamacpp-kotlin is licensed under Apache-2.0, and llama.cpp under MIT, for on-device inference integration.
- Gemma 3 1B IT Q4_K_M: Google Gemma model governed by the Gemma Terms of Use, not GPL; quantized GGUF release sourced from Unsloth.
- Android / AndroidX / Jetpack Compose / Kotlin: Platform and UI libraries governed by their respective licenses (commonly Apache-2.0).

On-device operation: AI scenario replies and related inference use a local offline model without relying on cloud quotas. Depending on the release, the model may be bundled at install time or require an additional download.

Local processing: Input and model inference are handled by on-device features. Do not enter highly confidential information or sensitive personal data.

Clear data: Clearing the local user dictionary may remove existing learned words. Back up any information you need before clearing.
